prediction_text: Direction: Hillary Clinton wins the 2016 US presidential election — the Costa Mesa ISAR forecasting panel's call is for Clinton over Donald Trump in the election of 8 November 2016. This is the panel-consensus call: the established, poll-leading candidate takes the White House. Coordinate: the 8 November 2016 result.
basis:
Card carries no tradition/system field as such; decided from the card's own genre: the card describes an international astrology conference in Costa Mesa holding an election forecasting panel in October 2016 and asks who will win, so the panel's collective astrological judgement is the object predicted, read by Western mundane astrology conventions.
systems_used: Western astrology (mundane election forecasting, panel consensus)
Reasoning: the card supplies no individual chart or configuration for this case — the only differentiators given are the panel setting itself and the fact that most polls favour Clinton. A conference panel call is a consensus artefact: absent a supplied dissenting configuration, the consensus reads with the established favourite (continuity/Saturnian establishment profile over the insurgent). This case is kept distinct from the companion 2016 case on the same batch list whose card singles out one panel astrologer with a prior Trump call — that distinguishing fact is not on this card and is not imported here. Magnitude: no landslide is claimed; the call is direction-only, at panel-consensus strength, confidence graded accordingly.
